system.description: The Assamites have spread over an immense territory and encountered a wider array of cultures than most other clans can conceive of. In life or unlife, you have traveled among many different peoples and gained an almost instinctive understanding of how to blend in without giving offense. You gain a bonus Trait on all challenges to move smoothly through a foreign society (though speaking the language is still a function of Linguistics), reflexively coming across as familiar and knowledgeable where other outlanders would flounder. This also covers tasks like appearing native in an area where you don't belong, such as an Assamite hiding among French pilgrims while evading pursuit through the markets of Constantinople.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
